states.RIF_STRONG: at least 3 independent dimensions, including TOPOLOGY or CROSS_PAGE_REPETITION, with no contradiction
states.ERROR_CANDIDATE: source expression conflicts with arithmetic/grammar or carries explicit correction marks

promotion_rules.rule: Unreadable text alone never promotes; OCR confidence is recognition evidence only.
An unknown coefficient may be solved from written total minus invariant components, but remains RIF_CANDIDATE until it matches an author fingerprint seen elsewhere.
A missing TRATTO label can be reconstructed only if node topology, recipe fingerprint and page-layout convention converge.
Repeated omission at the same topological position across several levels is treated as a structural-condition hypothesis before clerical omission.
Explicit author annotations such as ERRORE, strike-throughs or replacement totals create an AUTHOR_MARKED_ERROR object; the original remains preserved.
Small arithmetic deviations compatible with the author's rounding pattern are ROUNDING_OR_TRUNCATION, not automatically ERROR.
